change.name: 多镜头新人组
change.frontend: Added shared group dictionary entry and identity hints; login, dispatch, group filters, group overview, assignment and export reuse existing group-scoped logic.
change.backend: Added one MODES allowlist mapping; original 18 API mappings, permission rules, workflows, reports and storage schema unchanged.
change.existingData: No task/member moves, history rewrites, task resets, or production test writes. Leader, daily total and headcount use the existing group settings.

deployment.sequence: Prepare isolated compatible API using existing DB only, delegated backups, read-only code; validate; graceful Nginx reload; drain old workers/connections; atomic static index switch.
deployment.rollback: Do not return to API74 or the original prod80 frontend after exposing the new group, even when no current tasks/sessions exist: already-open prod81 pages may register later. Keep m_newcomer compatibility in both layers and use a guarded forward fix. Database is never rolled back.

proofs: 候选与 prod74 为独立进程，共享合成 WAL；候选启动不改旧状态，原管理员/单多镜标注/质检/验收会话全部直接可用
原有18组映射精确不变；m_newcomer 仅允许多镜，三种作业身份可登记，错模块/未知组/错口令与非管理员导入均拒绝
新人组完成导入→认领→提交→质检返修→重提→验收退回→标注/质检两条返修路径→通过；跨组标注/质检和单镜验收原子拒绝，多镜验收可按原权限处理
group:m_newcomer 组日设置、半人天人数与原乐观冲突规则可用；角色完整/增量同步按原组隔离，不泄漏其他组任务或组日记录
新组记录存在后，旧会话在候选与 prod74 两侧继续完成原单/多镜组保存；旧 API 全量校验及组日编辑正常；prod74 无新组写权限，切换后不能作为新组流量回退目标
两独立进程并发写同 WAL 仅一方版本成功、另一方409；同步后重试成功；跨进程同请求重复点击只提交一次，过期任务零写入
新人组任务/事件/小组/日报导出保留独立ID及中文组名，单镜导出不混入；通过/闭环与组日配置可见；旧任务和旧事件原文不变、无重复备份、SQLite完整性正常
